coverage.method: Read every original Chinese span alongside its complete English mapping, joining adjacent comments; checked all mappings are installed in actual candidate source, normalizing indentation/whitespace only for docstrings.

schema_class_clause_review.PatchDraftRequest: Presence distinguishes omission from explicit null; omitted accept_formal_revision means no acceptance, omitted source means no change. Preserved.
schema_class_clause_review.ScriptSpeechAdmission: Identified-unit speech admission on composition rejection; same SpeechAdmission.to_dict() shape. Preserved.
schema_class_clause_review.ScriptPatchResult: Successful changes to image/video prompts require immediate corresponding regeneration; speech_admission includes all identified-unit issues only when first issue is composition; unbound mention hints remain warnings. Preserved.

semantic_checks: Source validation before persistence, no silent fallback on missing meta.source, and current-capability/source reassessment preserved.
Schema-invalid drafts retain original malformed fields and non-dict placeholders; no silent unit loss/coercion or overwrite.
Formal-file revision conflict handling, server-only nonreused IDs, same-lock concurrency and no persistent invalid-input side effects preserved.
Hard versus soft violations, Agent/Web diagnostic distinction, locale rendering, readonly/no-cost preview and explicit consent/revision boundaries preserved.
Planning window cancellation versus running completion, candidate retention, gap endpoint, no successor enqueue and ledger-derived resume constraints preserved.
limits: This is bilingual semantic review, not an independent test rerun or model evaluation.
Coordinator separately reports actual 61 MCP input schemas equal despite five direct model-description occurrences changing; this report does not relabel exposed class docs as passive.
Review hashes delimit the exact candidate reviewed; later changes need reconciliation.
